1.word_for_word: चतुर्विंशे महेन्द्रस्य मखं व्यावर्त्य हेतुभिः । — In the twenty-fourth year the sacrifice of Lord Mahendra was reversed for various reasons.; कृष्णः प्रवर्तयामास गोवर्धन-मखोत्सवम् ॥ — Lord Kṛṣṇa initiated the sacrificial festival of Govardhana.; भूसुराणां क्रिया-गर्वं निरस्य स्वः-सुरेऊ च । — He rejected the pride of the actions of the earthly demigods and his own demigods.; मघवन्-मद-भङ्गाय तन्-मखं समवारयत् ॥ — To break the intoxication of Indra, he stopped the sacrifice.; ब्राह्मणाः कंसाद् भीताः स्वाश्रमस्था एव भगवन्तम् अभजन् । — The brāhmaṇas were afraid of Kaṁsa and worshiped the Supreme Personality of Godhead while remaining in their hermitages.; भगवान् अपि तत्रैव निवसन्न् इन्द्र-यागे कृत उद्यमो यैस् तान् गोपान् अपश्यद् इति सम्बन्धः ॥१॥ — This is the connection that the Supreme Personality of Godhead also resided there and saw the cowherd men who had performed the sacrifice to Indra.
1.translation: In the twenty-fourth year the sacrifice of Lord Mahendra was reversed for various reasons. Lord Kṛṣṇa initiated the sacrificial festival of Govardhana. He rejected the pride of the actions of the earthly demigods and his own demigods. To break the intoxication of Indra, he stopped the sacrifice. The brāhmaṇas were afraid of Kaṁsa and worshiped the Supreme Personality of Godhead while remaining in their hermitages. This is the connection that the Supreme Personality of Godhead also resided there and saw the cowherd men who had performed the sacrifice to Indra.

3.word_for_word: वृथा सम्भ्रमो न भवति मखोऽयम् इत्य् एवं चेत्, किम् अत्र फलम् ? — There is no vain confusion that this is a sacrifice, and if so, what is the fruit here?; का देवता? — What god?; केनाधिकारिणा ? — By what authority?; केन वा साधनेन साध्यते ? — By what means is it achieved?; ॥३॥ — ॥3॥
3.translation: There is no vain confusion that this is a sacrifice, and if so, what is the fruit here? What god? By what authority? By what means is it achieved? ॥3॥

4-5.word_for_word: एतद् ब्रूहि महान् कामो मम श्रवणे वर्तते । — Please tell me this, for I have great desire to hear it.; यद् वा, तव महान् कामो दृश्यत इति। — Or rather, that your great desire is seen.; तूष्णीं स्थितं प्रत्याह---नेति । — He replied, standing silent, "No.; सर्वात्मनां सर्वत्रात्म-दृष्टीनाम् ॥४॥ — They are all-pervading and omnipresent in their vision of the Self.; अत एव न विद्यते स्वः पर इति दृष्टिर् येषाम् इति स्व-पर-दृष्ट्य्-अभावाद् एव तत्-तद्-भेदा अमित्रादयोऽपि तेषां न सन्तीत्य् आह---अमित्रेति । — That is why he argues that those who have no view of themselves as others do not have the differences between them and others because of the absence of view of themselves and others.; न मित्रम् उदास्त उदासीनो विद्विड् येषां, तेषां कृत्यं सर्वं कर्म नैव गोपनीयं किञ्चिद् अस्तीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that those who have no friend, noble, indifferent, ignorant, all their actions and nothing to hide.; सत्य् अपि भेद-दर्शने उदासीनः शत्रुवद् वर्ज्यः, आत्म-तुल्यत्वात् सुहृन्-मन्त्रेषु न वर्जनीय इत्य् आह---उदासीन इति ॥५॥ — Even if it is true that one who is indifferent to seeing differences is to be avoided like an enemy, and since he is equal to the Self he should not be avoided in the mantras of friends, he argues that he is indifferent.
4-5.translation: Please tell me this, for I have great desire to hear it. Or rather, that your great desire is seen. He replied, standing silent, "No. They are all-pervading and omnipresent in their vision of the Self. That is why he argues that those who have no view of themselves as others do not have the differences between them and others because of the absence of view of themselves and others. This means that those who have no friend, noble, indifferent, ignorant, all their actions and nothing to hide. Even if it is true that one who is indifferent to seeing differences is to be avoided like an enemy, and since he is equal to the Self he should not be avoided in the mantras of friends, he argues that he is indifferent.

6.word_for_word: किं च, सुहृद्भिः सह विचार्य ज्ञात्वैव कर्म कर्तव्यं न तु गतानुगतिकत्व-मात्रेणेत्य् आह---ज्ञात्वेति । — Moreover, he argues that one should act knowingly after considering with one’s friends, and not merely by being a follower of the past.; अज्ञात्वा च तत्र विदुषो यथा तत्-कर्म-फलं स्यात् तथा नाविदुषः॥६॥ — And without knowing it, the learned there is as the fruit of that action, and not the ignorant.
6.translation: Moreover, he argues that one should act knowingly after considering with one’s friends, and not merely by being a follower of the past. And without knowing it, the learned there is as the fruit of that action, and not the ignorant.

7.word_for_word: भवताम् अयं क्रिया-योगः शास्त्रतोऽपि किं विचारितः प्रवृत्तो लौकिक आचार-प्राप्तो वेति साधु सोपपत्तिकं भण्यतां कथ्यताम् इति ॥७॥ — Have you considered this Yoga of action even according to the scriptures or have you practiced it or have you attained the worldly customs?
7.translation: Have you considered this Yoga of action even according to the scriptures or have you practiced it or have you attained the worldly customs?

8.word_for_word: पर्जन्यो वृष्टि-द्वारा भगवान् ईश्वर इति भक्ति-विशेषेण प्रीणनं सन्तर्पकं जीवनं मृत-प्रायाणां तृणादीनां प्राणदम् ॥८॥ — The rain is the source of rain and the Supreme Lord is pleasing to the Lord with special devotion He satisfies life and gives life to grass and other things that are almost dead.
8.translation: The rain is the source of rain and the Supreme Lord is pleasing to the Lord with special devotion He satisfies life and gives life to grass and other things that are almost dead.

9.word_for_word: ततः किम् इत्य् अत आह---वयं चान्ये नराः । — Then what is it?” Then he said, “We and other men.; वार्-मुचां पतिम् ईश्वरं तद् रेतसा सिद्धैः द्रव्यैः क्रतुभिः यजन्ति ॥९॥ — They worship the Lord of the water-muchas with the semen of that sacrifice with the perfected objects.
9.translation: Then what is it?” Then he said, “We and other men. They worship the Lord of the water-muchas with the semen of that sacrifice with the perfected objects.

10.word_for_word: उपजीवन्त्य् उपजीविकां कल्पयन्ति धर्मार्थ-काम-सिद्धये । — They live on their livelihood and make it their livelihood to fulfill their religious duties, wealth and desires.; ननु कृयादिभिर् जीवन्ति किम् इन्द्रेण ? — If they live by actions and other things, what about Indra?; तत्राह---पुंसाम् इति । — There he argues that it is for men.; फल-भावनः फल-साधकः । — The feeling of fruit is the seeker of fruit.; पर्जन्यं विना कृष्यादि-वैफल्याद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१०.११॥ — Without rain, agriculture and other activities are fruitless, this means.
10.translation: They live on their livelihood and make it their livelihood to fulfill their religious duties, wealth and desires. If they live by actions and other things, what about Indra? There he argues that it is for men. The feeling of fruit is the seeker of fruit. Without rain, agriculture and other activities are fruitless, this means.

12.word_for_word: इन्द्राय मन्युं जनयन्न् इति कोप-जनन-द्वारा गर्व-पर्वताद् इन्द्रम् अवतारयितुं देवता-निराकरणं न त्व् अयम् एवाभिप्राय इत्य् अर्थः ॥१२॥ — By causing anger to Indra, this means that the demigods were not intended to bring down Indra from the mountain of pride by arousing anger.
12.translation: By causing anger to Indra, this means that the demigods were not intended to bring down Indra from the mountain of pride by arousing anger.

13.word_for_word: प्रथमं तावत् कर्म-वादेन देवान् निराकरोति---कर्मणेति । — First, he rejects the gods by the argument of karma, saying that they are by karma.; ननु जडात् कर्मणः केवलात् कथं फल-सिद्धिः स्याद् इति चेत्, अहो अशीलित-मीमांसानां स्वम् अतिविलसिता श्रद्धा कर्मणां फल-कारणत्वे वचनतोऽवगते किं ततोऽनुपपन्नं नाम ॥१३॥ — If, indeed, it is asked how the fruits of dull action alone can be attained, then, oh, the self-exalted faith of the unpolished mystics, who understand from the words that actions are the cause of the fruits, what is therefore not appropriate?
13.translation: First, he rejects the gods by the argument of karma, saying that they are by karma. If, indeed, it is asked how the fruits of dull action alone can be attained, then, oh, the self-exalted faith of the unpolished mystics, who understand from the words that actions are the cause of the fruits, what is therefore not appropriate?

14.word_for_word: केचित् पुनर् अतिसाहस-भीताः कर्म-परतन्त्रम् ईश्वरं मन्यन्ते, तन्-मतम् अनूद्य निराकरोति---अस्ति चेद् इति । — Some, again, are afraid of too much courage and believe that God is independent of action, and rejects that view by saying that if He exists.; स्वयं कर्मभिर् अलिप्तोऽन्येषां जीवानां कर्मणां फल-रूपी फल-दाता कर्तारं भजते तत्-तत्-कर्म-फल-दानेन ॥१४॥ — He Himself, who is not tainted by the actions of other living beings, who is the giver of the fruits of their actions, worships the doer by bestowing the fruits of those actions.
14.translation: Some, again, are afraid of too much courage and believe that God is independent of action, and rejects that view by saying that if He exists. He Himself, who is not tainted by the actions of other living beings, who is the giver of the fruits of their actions, worships the doer by bestowing the fruits of those actions.

15.word_for_word: अतः कर्मण एव फल-सिद्धेस् तत् पारतन्त्र्ये चाजागलस्तन-तुल्यत्वान् न देवतया कृत्य-मित्यान् न देवतया कृत्यम् इत्य् आह---किम् इन्द्रेणेति। — Therefore, since it is the perfection of the fruit of action itself, and since it is equal to the breast of the awakened in transcendence, it is not the act of the deity, nor is it the act of the deity, he argues, what about Indra?; ननु कर्मणो ऽपि प्रवृत्तिर् अन्तर्याम्य् अपेक्षैव कथं सर्वया देवताया अनुपयोग इत्य् आशङ्क्याह---स्वभाव-विहितम् इति। — If, indeed, the instinct of action is also in the innermost, how can it not be used by all the deities?; स्वभावेन प्राक्तन-संस्कारेणैव विहितं यत् कर्म तद् अन्यथाकर्तुम् अनीशेन ॥१५॥ — The action which is prescribed by nature by the past rituals is not to be done otherwise by the Lord.
15.translation: Therefore, since it is the perfection of the fruit of action itself, and since it is equal to the breast of the awakened in transcendence, it is not the act of the deity, nor is it the act of the deity, he argues, what about Indra? If, indeed, the instinct of action is also in the innermost, how can it not be used by all the deities? The action which is prescribed by nature by the past rituals is not to be done otherwise by the Lord.

16.word_for_word: एतद् विवृणोति---स्वभाव-तन्त्र इति । — He explains this as the system of nature.; प्रवृत्तेः संस्काराधीनत्वात् किम् अन्तर्यामिणेत्य् अर्थः ॥१६॥ — Since instinct is subject to rituals, what is the meaning of the innermost?
16.translation: He explains this as the system of nature. Since instinct is subject to rituals, what is the meaning of the innermost?

17.word_for_word: तस्मात् स्वभावतो निष्पन्नस्य कर्मण एव सर्व-कारणत्वात् कर्मैव पूज्यम् इत्य् आह---देहान् इति सार्धेन ॥१७॥ — Therefore, since action alone, which arises from its own nature, is the cause of all, it is argued that action alone is to be worshipped.
17.translation: Therefore, since action alone, which arises from its own nature, is the cause of all, it is argued that action alone is to be worshipped.

18.word_for_word: संपूजयेत् संमानयेत् । — One should worship and honor.; ननु देवतोद्देशेन द्रव्य-त्यागात्मकत्वात् कर्मणः कथं देवतां विना सिद्धिर् इत्य् आशङ्क्य कर्माङ्ग-मात्रं देवतेति पक्षम् उपसंहरन्न् इव हेतु-वादम् अश्रित्यान्याम् एव देवतां समर्थयते, अञ्जसेति ॥१८॥ — Indeed, since action is based on the sacrifice of material things for the sake of the deity, how can it be accomplished without the deity?
18.translation: One should worship and honor. Indeed, since action is based on the sacrifice of material things for the sake of the deity, how can it be accomplished without the deity?

19.word_for_word: हेतु-बलेनैव विपक्षे दोषम् आह---आजीव्येति । — He argues that the opposition is faulty by the force of reason alone, that it is alive.; उपजीवति सेवते ॥१९॥ — He lives and serves.
19.translation: He argues that the opposition is faulty by the force of reason alone, that it is alive. He lives and serves.

20.word_for_word: स्व-वृत्तिं वक्तुं दृष्टान्तत्वेन वर्णानां वृत्ति-भेदम् आह---वर्तेतेति । — As an illustration to explain their own instincts, he argues for the difference in instincts of the varnas.; ब्रह्मणा वेदाध्यापनादिना ॥२०॥ — By the Brahman, by teaching the Vedas and so on.
20.translation: As an illustration to explain their own instincts, he argues for the difference in instincts of the varnas. By the Brahman, by teaching the Vedas and so on.

21.word_for_word: वैश्य-वृत्तेश् चातुर्-विध्यम् आह---कृषीति । — He argues that there are four types of Vaishya occupation: agriculture.; कृषि-वाणिज्य-सहिता गो-रक्षा एवं त्रयम् । — Agriculture and commerce, along with cow protection, and so on.; कुसीदं वृद्धि-जीवनं चतुर्थम् ॥२१॥ — Kusida is the fourth life of growth.
21.translation: He argues that there are four types of Vaishya occupation: agriculture. Agriculture and commerce, along with cow protection, and so on. Kusida is the fourth life of growth.

22.word_for_word: ननु गवाम् अपि वृत्तिर् महेन्द्राधीनैवेत्य् आशङ्क्य निरीश्वर-साङ्ख्य-मताश्रयेण निराकरोति---सत्त्वम् इति श्लोक-द्वयेन । — Indeed, he suspects that even the instinct of cows is under the control of Indra, and refutes it on the basis of the atheistic Sāṅkhya view, saying that it is the mode of goodness in two verses.; अन्योन्यं स्त्री-पुरुष-योगेन ॥२२॥ — By the combination of men and women.
22.translation: Indeed, he suspects that even the instinct of cows is under the control of Indra, and refutes it on the basis of the atheistic Sāṅkhya view, saying that it is the mode of goodness in two verses. By the combination of men and women.

23.word_for_word: सर्वत इति । — It is everywhere.; समुद्र-शिलोषरादिष्व् अपि वृष्टि-दर्शनान् न प्रेक्षावत् पूर्वकत्वं वृष्टेर् इति भावः । — This means that even in the sea, rocks, etc., the sight of rain is not as precedent as the sight of rain.; तैर् एव मेघैर् एव । — By those same clouds.; सिध्यन्ति जीवन्ति ॥२३॥ — They are accomplished and live.
23.translation: It is everywhere. This means that even in the sea, rocks, etc., the sight of rain is not as precedent as the sight of rain. By those same clouds. They are accomplished and live.

24.word_for_word: तथापि योग-क्षेमार्थं देवतापेक्षेति चेद् अत आह---न नः पुर इति । — However, if it is said that the deity is required for the sake of yoga and safety, then he argues that it is not our city.; पुरः पत्तनानि । — The towns in front.; जन-पदा देशाः । — People-foot countries.; अस्माकं योग-क्षेम-हेतुर् वन-शैलादय एवेति भावः ॥२४॥ — This means that forests, mountains and other places are the cause of our yogic well-being.
24.translation: However, if it is said that the deity is required for the sake of yoga and safety, then he argues that it is not our city. The towns in front. People-foot countries. This means that forests, mountains and other places are the cause of our yogic well-being.

25.word_for_word: ब्राह्मणान् अपि सङ्गृह्णन् निगमयति, तस्माद् इति । — He also collects the Brahmanas and incorporates them, therefore.; स्वयम् उत्प्रेक्षित-याग-प्रयोग-कल्पनाम् आह---य इन्द्र-याग-संभारा इति सार्ध-पञ्चभिः संभाराः साधनानि ॥२५॥ — He himself argues for the imagination of the use of the sacrifices indicated by the five and a half preparations for the sacrifice of Indra.
25.translation: He also collects the Brahmanas and incorporates them, therefore. He himself argues for the imagination of the use of the sacrifices indicated by the five and a half preparations for the sacrifice of Indra.

26.word_for_word: सूपं मौद्गम् । — The soup is a maudgam.; पायसं केवले पयसि पक्वम् । — Payasam is cooked in milk only.; संयावादयो गो-धूमादि-विक्रियाः । — The reactions of cow-smoking and others are combinations.; क्रमश् च सूप-पायसयोः श्रुत्या दोहस्यार्थतोऽन्येषां पाठतः ॥२६॥ — The order of soup and rice is also described in the Vedas and in the meaning of milking and in the reading of others.
26.translation: The soup is a maudgam. Payasam is cooked in milk only. The reactions of cow-smoking and others are combinations. The order of soup and rice is also described in the Vedas and in the meaning of milking and in the reading of others.

27.word_for_word: याग-शोभार्थं श्रद्धोत्पादनार्थं चाह---हूयन्ताम् इति । — To beautify the sacrifice and to produce faith, he says, “Let them be offered.”; धेनु-दक्षिणाः धेनु-सहिता दक्षिणाः, ता एव वा दक्षिणाः । — Cow-gifts are gifts with cows, or the same gifts.; वो युष्माभिः ॥२७॥ — Wo yuṣmabhiḥ ॥27॥
27.translation: To beautify the sacrifice and to produce faith, he says, “Let them be offered.” Cow-gifts are gifts with cows, or the same gifts. Wo yuṣmabhiḥ ॥27॥

28.word_for_word: यवसं तृणम् ॥२८-२९॥ — Barley is the grass.28-2

30.word_for_word: सर्वान् शिरः-कम्पेनानुमोदयन्न् आह---गो-ब्राह्मणाद्रीणाम् इति । — Shaking his head, he approved everyone and said, “They are the cows and the Brahmins and the mountains.”; मह्यं मम च॥३०॥ — To me and to me.
30.translation: Shaking his head, he approved everyone and said, “They are the cows and the Brahmins and the mountains.” To me and to me.

32.word_for_word: तद्-द्रव्येण तेन महेन्द्र-मख-द्रव्येण गिरिं द्विजान् प्रति यथा-यथम् ॥३२॥ — The ingredients of the sacrifice of Indra were offered to the brāhmaṇas on the mountain in various ways.
32.translation: The ingredients of the sacrifice of Indra were offered to the brāhmaṇas on the mountain in various ways.

33.word_for_word: बलीन् उपहृत्य दत्त्वा । — Giving gifts to the strong.; आदृताः सादराः ॥३३॥ — They are respected and respected.
33.translation: Giving gifts to the strong. They are respected and respected.

34.word_for_word: अनडुद्-युक्तान्य् उत्तमानडुद्भिर् युक्तानि । — They are equipped with non-oats and are equipped with excellent oats.; स-द्विजाशिषो द्विजा-शीर्भिः सहिताः ॥३४॥ — They were accompanied by the blessings of the brahmins and the heads of the brahmins.
34.translation: They are equipped with non-oats and are equipped with excellent oats. They were accompanied by the blessings of the brahmins and the heads of the brahmins.

35.word_for_word: गोप-विश्रम्भणं गोपानां विश्वास-जनकं रूपं गतः प्राप्तः सन् बलिम् उपहारम् आदद् अभक्षयत् ॥३५॥ — Having attained the form of the cowherd men whose confidence he had attained Bali accepted the offering and ate it
35.translation: Having attained the form of the cowherd men whose confidence he had attained Bali accepted the offering and ate it

36.word_for_word: तस्मै आत्मने आत्मना स्वयं व्रज-जनैः सह नमश्-चक्रे । — He himself, along with the people of Vraja, offered his obeisances to the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; अहो इति सार्ध-श्लोकं पठन् ॥३६॥ — Oh, reading half a verse.
36.translation: He himself, along with the people of Vraja, offered his obeisances to the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Oh, reading half a verse.

37-38.word_for_word: काम-रूपी सर्पादि-रूपः । — The form of the snake in the form of desire.; अस्मै अद्रये । — To this mountain.; शर्मणे क्षेमाय ॥३७॥ — for shame and for the sake of peace.; कर्मैवालं प्राक्-स्वभावो गुणो वा — Karmaivalam is the pre-nature or quality; कर्माङ्गं वा तद्-वशो वा महेशः । — Whether it is a part of action or under its control, Lord Mahesh.; वार्ता-कर्त्री-देवतेतीयम् उक्ता — The news-maker-goddess is said to be; देव-क्षोभे षण्-मती न त्व् अभीष्टा ॥३८॥ — The six-fold is not desired in the disturbance of the gods.
37-38.translation: The form of the snake in the form of desire. To this mountain. for shame and for the sake of peace. Karmaivalam is the pre-nature or quality Whether it is a part of action or under its control, Lord Mahesh. The news-maker-goddess is said to be The six-fold is not desired in the disturbance of the gods.
